releaseNotes:
• Instagram Limit Bypass Fix: Solved race conditions where Instagram could remain open and interactive after daily limit exhaustion
• Immediate Quota Block: QuotaEngine.recordUsage synchronously signals limit exhaustion and updates in-memory cache with zero delay
• Singleton Cache Scope & Mutex: Eliminated CoroutineScope leaks and racing clears in background cache refresh
• Atomic Cache Swap: Prevents transient unblocked states during cache recalculation
• Cold Start Warmup: Cache is actively populated during application launch
